description: Source code for Git's configuration file parser and related utilities, including handling of include directives, parsing key-value pairs, and managing configuration sources.

classes.name: config_source
classes.description: Represents a configuration source, such as a file or buffer, with function pointers for reading characters.

classes.name: config_include_data
classes.description: Holds data related to including other configuration files, including include depth, repository info, and remote URLs.

classes.name: parse_event_data
classes.description: Stores previous parsing event type and offset for handling config parsing events.

methods.name: config_file_fgetc
methods.description: Reads a character from a file source.

methods.name: config_file_ungetc
methods.description: Pushes a character back onto the file source.

methods.name: config_file_ftell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the file source.

methods.name: config_buf_fgetc
methods.description: Reads a character from a buffer source.

methods.name: config_buf_ungetc
methods.description: Pushes a character back onto the buffer source.

methods.name: config_buf_ftell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the buffer source.

methods.name: git_config_include
methods.description: Handles inclusion of additional config files based on include directives.

methods.name: handle_path_include
methods.description: Processes include paths, expanding and resolving relative paths.

methods.name: prepare_include_condition_pattern
methods.description: Prepares a pattern for include condition matching, handling path interpolation.

methods.name: include_by_gitdir
methods.description: Checks if a git directory matches a pattern.

methods.name: include_by_branch
methods.description: Checks if current branch matches a pattern.

methods.name: add_remote_url
methods.description: Adds remote URLs from config to a list.

methods.name: populate_remote_urls
methods.description: Populates remote URLs from the repository configuration.

methods.name: forbid_remote_url
methods.description: Enforces restriction on remote URL configuration.

methods.name: at_least_one_url_matches_glob
methods.description: Checks if any remote URL matches a glob pattern.

methods.name: include_by_remote_url
methods.description: Checks if remote URLs match a pattern.

methods.name: include_condition_is_true
methods.description: Evaluates if a conditional include pattern is true.

methods.name: git_config_parse_key
methods.description: Parses a config key into section and variable parts.

methods.name: config_parse_pair
methods.description: Parses a key-value pair and applies a callback function.

methods.name: git_config_parse_parameter
methods.description: Parses a configuration parameter string into key and value.

methods.name: get_next_char
methods.description: Reads the next character, handling special cases like CR and line length.

methods.name: parse_value
methods.description: Parses a value from the config source, handling quotes and comments.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Reads a key and value from the config source and applies a callback.

methods.name: do_config_from
methods.description: Main function to parse a config source with a callback.
